verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's own docs say it offers OpenFeature Providers, and it advertises OpenFeature compatibility. Its GitHub repo claims the partnership means users are never locked into one vendor, so the core of the story is delivered first-party. However, the evidence does not show which languages are covered, and nothing confirms provider parity with the native SDKs. Missing for 10: the documented list of languages with OpenFeature providers, evidence of feature parity (targeting, multivariate, identities) through the providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can use the vendor through OpenFeature providers so my flag code isn't locked to one vendor's SDK API

citations.quote: We currently offer [OpenFeature Providers](https://docs.openfeature.dev/docs/reference/concepts/provider) for the following languages:
OpenFeature Compatibility: Use Flagsmith with OpenFeature
Thanks to our partnership with OpenFeature, you are never locked into one vendor.
